feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 5 (y = 0.05 m) raised s-bend progress from 0.04 to 0.1475 with oscillation 0.1366, and iteration 6 (y = 0.07 m) gave 0.15 with oscillation 0.1407 and line loss unchanged at one event per run. Iterations 2 to 4 at y = 0.03 m, under kp, pitch and drivetrain changes, stayed at 0.04, so forward lead is the lever that worked. The gain from 0.05 to 0.07 m was only about 0.0025 progress, so I expect little from 0.08 m. Decide from the race. If s-bend progress is flat (about 0.15) and oscillation stays below 0.16, forward lead is exhausted: keep y = 0.07 m and test a drivetrain change. If oscillation rises above 0.16 or line loss rises on the s-bend or slalom, revert to y = 0.07 m. If progress rises clearly, keep y = 0.08 m and check whether any track gets closer to completion.
requested_changes: If s-bend progress is flat (about 0.15) with oscillation below 0.16, revert to y = 0.07 m and try wheel_track 0.10 m with mass 0.8 kg, keeping the 16 mm contiguous layout at ±0.048 m. Evidence: iteration 4 drivetrain change left s-bend at 0.04, but at y = 0.03 m, where lead was the limit, so the drivetrain effect has not been tested with lead in place.

If steering_oscillation rises above 0.16 or line_loss_events rise above one per run on the s-bend or slalom, set sensor y to 0.07 m (the iteration 6 value). Evidence: iteration 6 oscillation was 0.1407 with line loss at one per run, and iteration 5 was 0.1366.
Do not widen the pitch beyond the contiguous 16 mm layout at ±0.048 m. Evidence: iteration 4's 20 mm pitch cut slalom progress from 0.104 (iteration 2) to 0.035, with no gain on the s-bend.
